title: Design two tables

checks.name: a valid member can be inserted
checks.query: INSERT INTO members (id, email, name) VALUES (1, 'ada@example.org', 'Ada'); SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members;

checks.name: joined_on is filled in by default
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members WHERE id = 1 AND joined_on IS NOT NULL

checks.name: a member with no email is rejected
checks.query: INSERT INTO members (id, email, name) VALUES (2, NULL, 'Bob')

checks.name: a member with no name is rejected
checks.query: INSERT INTO members (id, email, name) VALUES (2, 'bob@example.org', NULL)

checks.name: a duplicate email is rejected
checks.query: INSERT INTO members (id, email, name) VALUES (3, 'ada@example.org', 'Other Ada')

checks.name: a duplicate id is rejected
checks.query: INSERT INTO members (id, email, name) VALUES (1, 'new@example.org', 'New')

checks.name: a valid loan can be inserted
checks.query: INSERT INTO loans (id, member_id, book_title, days) VALUES (1, 1, 'Dune', 14); SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loans;

checks.name: loans of 1 day and of 30 days are allowed
checks.query: INSERT INTO loans (id, member_id, book_title, days) VALUES (2, 1, 'Emma', 1), (3, 1, 'Ulysses', 30); SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loans;

checks.name: a loan for an unknown member is rejected
checks.query: INSERT INTO loans (id, member_id, book_title, days) VALUES (4, 999, 'Dune', 14)

checks.name: a loan of 0 days is rejected
checks.query: INSERT INTO loans (id, member_id, book_title, days) VALUES (5, 1, 'Dune', 0)

checks.name: a loan of 31 days is rejected
checks.query: INSERT INTO loans (id, member_id, book_title, days) VALUES (6, 1, 'Dune', 31)

checks.name: a loan with no book title is rejected
checks.query: INSERT INTO loans (id, member_id, book_title, days) VALUES (7, 1, NULL, 7)

hints: Every column that must have a value needs NOT NULL. email also needs UNIQUE.
joined_on DATE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE
member_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES members(id), and days INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (days BETWEEN 1 AND 30)
